name: airflow-remote-jupyter-notebook
description: This plugin is designed to allow the execution of Jupyter Notebooks remotely from within an Airflow DAG. By using the plugin, users can integrate and manage Jupyter Notebook workflows as part of their Airflow pipelines, ensuring that data analysis or machine learning code can be orchestrated and run automatically within the DAG scheduling system.
